title: Grateful Dead Live at Desert Sky Pavilion on 1994-03-05
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Teac DA-P20 @ 16/48; Transfer Information:Sony R500>Tascam HD-P2 @ 16/48> Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44 By Keo; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded tape with strong crowd presence and several highlight moments, but the show itself divides listeners.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its vivid audience ambience that many soundboard tapes lack, delivering clear energy especially on tracks like The Stranger, Stagger Lee, China>Rider and a soaring Stella Blue. While one reviewer rates the performance highly, another brands the concert as one of the worst in the era, leaving the overall impression mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments highlight a good‑to‑great audience recording and several standout songs (4‑star rating), but another reviewer gives a zero‑star verdict on the show overall; averaging these divergent views yields a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures crowd energy and ambience that soundboard mixes miss; no specific complaints about clarity or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set noted for strong openers and high energy; second set includes a concise China>Rider and an acclaimed Stella Blue, though overall impression varies widely among listeners.
